verdict.rationale: Evidence shows SvelteKit supports rendering strategies (SSR, SSG via adapter-static, CSR/SPA) and is positioned as a Next.js/Nuxt-equivalent meta-framework, implying server rendering capability, but no citation explicitly documents streaming SSR or progressive hydration for faster interactivity. Missing for 10: explicit docs on streaming SSR (e.g., streamed promises in load functions), performance benchmarks or community validation of streaming reducing time-to-interactive.
